settings.agentPolicy.protectState.descri: 在 Claude 的沙盒中运行 Claude Code 智能体的 shell 命令，在 macOS 沙盒中运行 Kiro 智能体和完全访问（绕过）模式下的 Codex 及 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，并阻止其读取 Tallpine 的安装令牌、会话密钥、数据库、GitHub 令牌、应用配置文件和移动端配对密钥。tallpine CLI 仍可正常使用。目前仅支持 macOS 上的 Claude Code、Kiro 和完全访问模式的 Codex 及 DeepSeek Harness；沙盒模式下的 Codex 及 DeepSeek Harness、其他智能体和其他系统照常运行。开启期间，Claude Code 不会加载提交到仓库中的智能体配置（项目 .claude 设置、hooks）。仅保护文件：不限制网络访问。默认关闭；项目可以开启，但不能关闭。
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.on: 开启（Claude Code、Kiro、完全访问的 Codex 及 DeepSeek Harness；macOS）
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.creden: Hardened profile: paths hidden from agents in addition to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.kube, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure, ~/.docker/config.json, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.pypirc and the gh and git credential stores. Absolute or ~/-relative, comma-separated.
Hardened profile: paths exempted from credential hiding. Prefer an SSH agent socket over allowing ~/.ssh.
settings.agentPolicy.protectState.devToo: Local dev tooling in the sandbox

When the sandbox is on: lets test servers, dev servers and the merge gate bind unix sockets under the session's own temp dir, and lets the Xcode tool shims (git, clang) write their xcrun_db cache files in the per-user temp dir. Those two are the only openings; Tallpine secrets stay hidden. Strict blocks it (tests that bind unix sockets then fail).
settings.agentPolicy.crossProjectOrchest: 编排器可与其他项目协作
允许此项目的编排器列出其他项目的编排器并向其发送消息（不包括其工作者）、注册新项目，以及配置并启动由它创建的项目的编排器。来自其他编排器的消息会作为不受信任的数据送达智能体。每个操作都会被审计。默认关闭；组织策略可强制关闭。
settings.agentPolicy.devMode.label: Unfenced development (Dev mode): orchestrators can do anything
settings.agentPolicy.devMode.description: WARNING: lets every project's orchestrator do anything you can in Tallpine, including cross-project orchestrator start and config and any setting, and turns the protectState sandbox off for orchestrators (workers keep it). Workers stay limited to their own session. Only you can change this through the app, but an orchestrator can read the install token while Dev mode is on, so its access can outlast it: rotate the install token after turning Dev mode off.
